description: FREE onchain heartbeat for Base: current gas price and EIP-1559 base fee (wei + gwei) plus the latest block number and timestamp. One call, no payment, no wallet. The zero-friction primitive every onchain agent checks on a loop. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
